effects.text: **Once per turn**, after you hit with a weapon or Unarmed Strike, this **expends a spell slot** of the level set in your **Slot Level** counter (deducted from your spellbook automatically) to deal the extra damage above: **1d8 + 1d8 per slot level** of Necrotic. Set **Slot Level** to the slot you're spending first (e.g. `!cc "Slot Level" =3`).

onTrue.text: **Enhanced Ruinous Smite** (L14+): until the end of your next turn, attack the smitten creature with `-criton 19` so it suffers a Critical Hit on a 19-20 (or set it persistently with `!csettings criton 19`, reverting to `20` afterward).
